title: The session page: a Raw link to the log and transcript, and each ask linked to its raw line

chat.text: You asked to click through from a session to its raw log. A Sonnet task mastermind proves what the session page shows today with screenshots, then adds only what is missing: a Raw link (task log and transcript) in the header, and a link from every ask in the Coverage tab to the raw prompt line it came from.

message.text:
task-mastermind-session-detail-raw: Landed and idle. The session detail page now has Raw links (`task.jsonl` and `transcript`) in its header, and each Coverage ask has a `line N` link to the transcript. Both changes are in commit `566b6926f`, and the task log is committed as `b8ce82a37`.

I didn't run `merge.mjs`, because I edited two files in the main tree instead of using a worktree. I also skipped the docs smoke-test and the fresh-eyes review. The Coverage tab showed no refined prompts for the session I checked, so the new `line N` links haven't been seen on real data.

The session detail header now has Raw links (task.jsonl and transcript), and each Coverage ask has a `line N` link to its transcript line (commit 566b6926f). I saw the header links in the 1200 shot only; the Coverage tab was empty on the session I checked (its refined cards come from ext/Refine, outside my fence), so the ask links are untested on real data. I edited the main tree, so merge.mjs was not run. Docs: /framework/ai/sessions/doc/ui/detail-layout.md.
